name: anime-recommender-web
//packageManager: Pin pnpm so corepack uses the SAME version in Docker/CI as locally — without this, corepack grabs latest (pnpm 11.x), which mismatches the lockfile generator and changes build-script behavior.
description: Next.js (App Router) frontend — streaming RAG UX + Clerk auth
author: Zain Ul Abdin

pnpm.//: pnpm 10 blocks lifecycle/build scripts unless explicitly approved. In a --frozen-lockfile Docker build that's a hard error, so we allow-list the packages that genuinely need a native build: sharp (next/image), esbuild (vitest), plus Clerk's + the resolver's postinstalls.
pnpm.//overrides: Transitive deps we don't declare but that carry advisories the CI dependency audit blocks on. vitest was bumped 2.x -> 3.x directly (GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp, CRITICAL); these two arrive underneath other packages, so an override is the only way to force a safe version. Drop an entry once the parent ships a fixed range on its own.
